caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and initialized to Overall Level 3 per Security Policy
description: The Luna® PCI-E for Luna® IS cryptographic module features powerful cryptographic processing and hardware key management for applications where performance and security are the priority. The multi-chip embedded hardware cryptographic module offers hardware-based key management and cryptographic operations to protect sensitive keys. The cryptographic boundary of the module is defined to encompass all components inside the secure enclosure on the PCI-E card.
